**Migration done in `packages/`.** 36 calls across 12 files now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

All 12 pass `node --check`. No `db.query` left outside vendor.

Two calls remain in [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says do not edit. Upgrades overwrite it.

`cache.query` is a separate API. Left alone.

Next: drop `db.query` from [lib/db.js:13](lib/db.js:13) once vendor is off it.
